# Ruijie / Reyee

Cover RG-RAP access points (including RG-RAP2260(G)), switches, gateways, cloud/controller management, and RG-EST wireless bridge families. Check exact hardware revision, firmware, PoE requirements, adoption state, SSID/VLAN mapping, channel plan, client load, RF metrics, and logs. Do not assume Reyee cloud features map one-to-one to enterprise Ruijie CLI.
